Normalization: Single native chronological execution; owned bucket becomes acceleration-data-native and account becomes ${account}. Raw calls retain actual virtual-host authority, operation, path/query, request checksum-mode and checksum/metadata fields, response status/error, deterministic headers, copy checksums, list keys and binary body SHA256+length. Authentication and signing dates are freshly produced by replay. Request IDs, HTTP transport/CloudFront headers, SDK diagnostic headers, variable dates and list LastModified are excluded from assertions but retained in evidence. Actor-specific enhanced AccessDenied text remains in evidence; replay checks native code/status. Control prerequisites use SDK calls; cleanup and client-only dotted-name endpoint rejection remain evidence-only. Presigned calls are regenerated with the observed signing region, authority, headers and 120-second expiry. Reopen is a local SQLite persistence assertion, not an AWS operation. Native admission timing is observation, not an emulated speed or delay SLA.
